summary.text: Desiree Morton is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 46 (Fargo) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Desiree Morton's service as "House since 2025". The member page lists Desiree Morton's committee assignments as including the Education and the Transportation standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Desiree Morton's occupation as Retired.
It lists education as BS, Education, NDSU.
Desiree Morton is listed as married to Steven with 5 children.
